entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse I purchased. I'd like to start the process for a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, order number VF88-011925.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's really just a preference. It works perfectly, but I've worn it for a couple of weeks and I just don't find the silicone band comfortable for all-day wear. I was hoping to return it and maybe get a credit to put towards one of your other models.
Understood. So no defect, just not the right fit for you. Let me just pull up our return policy to confirm the eligibility for you. One moment.
Sure, take your time. I was a little concerned it might be too late, especially with wearable items and potential hygiene or sanitation rules.
That's a valid point. Some items do have stricter rules. However, I've just checked our internal system... and our standard policy allows for returns within 90 days of the delivery date.
Oh, 90 days? I was expecting something much shorter. So, I'm okay then?
Yes, absolutely. According to the policy I have here, since it was delivered 20 days ago, you're well within the timeframe. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
That's fantastic news. I really appreciate that. I was all prepared to negotiate for a partial credit or something. This is much easier.

Not a problem at all, Alex. We want to make sure our VIP customers are taken care of. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Perfect. That's everything I needed. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
